description: GIVEN one root config whose rootTranslationsPath is in project a of a multi-project workspace, as ng add writes it for the first project WHEN the keys of project b are extracted THEN they are written to the default folder of b, the translations of a are left alone and a notice on stderr names the folder written to
stderrMatches: The translations folder of the config, projects/a/public/i18n, is outside project 'b' \(projects/b\)\. Writing to projects/b/src/assets/i18n instead\.
